$Comment: Crafting XP at the Carving Bench: every finished carve on the bench's everyday action, Carve,
trains Crafting on a server running MMO Skill Tree.
The Target scopes this to that one action of that one station, so a Carve action some other pack
ships is left alone. RPG Stations forwards each PerCycleContributions entry on every completed
cycle, and MMO Skill Tree pays it as XP in the skill Param names; the action's own
ContributionScale, if it has one, has already scaled the Amount. Without MMO Skill Tree nothing
listens on the mmoskilltree:skill_xp channel, so the entry goes nowhere and nothing else happens.
The bench's event-only action has a file of its own, Mmo_Hallows_Eve_Carving_Hallowed.json.
